name: 갑자기 분위기 싸해질 필요 없잖아요 (Awkward Silence)

lines.lyric_translation: Let’s smile first
Let’s just smile
If you cry then laugh, they say you’ll get a horned butt
Let’s just pretend to be deceived and smile
Words that compare you to others
Words that don’t understand your heart
All of those little things

lines.lyric: Neoye sojunghan haruye joeun gibuneul nallil piryo eopseo
lines.lyric_translation: Don’t let it ruin your precious day

lines.lyric_hangul: 날릴 필요 없어 그럴 이유 없어
lines.lyric_translation: There’s no reason for that

lines.lyric_hangul: 빨간 불 같은 정색은 멈춰 네 주변을 멈춰
lines.lyric_translation: Don’t be so serious like a red light / Just stop whatever is around you
Don’t make silence flow
That’s no fun and time’s too precious

lines.lyric: Oh my gosh jyae jom bwa gibuni wanjeon uulhae
lines.lyric_hangul: Oh my god, 쟤 좀 봐 기분이 완전 우울해
lines.lyric_translation: Oh my gosh, look at him he’s so depressed

lines.lyric: Insang pyeo jureum saenggyeo aebeolle dwella
lines.lyric_hangul: 인상 펴 주름 생겨 애벌레 될라
lines.lyric_translation: Stop frowning, you’re gonna get wrinkles like a caterpillar
I know everything’s so annoying but
Like awkward silence
A crow is passing
No need for the vibes to grow sour
Just be cool

lines.lyric: Utgo neomgineun ge mamcheoreom shwipjin anchiman baby
lines.lyric_hangul: 웃고 넘기는 게 맘처럼 쉽진 않지만 baby
lines.lyric_translation: It’s not easy to just laugh it off baby

lines.lyric: Geu balgeun eolgure eoduun pyojeong jitji mayo
lines.lyric_hangul: 그 밝은 얼굴에 어두운 표정 짓지 마요
lines.lyric_translation: But don’t make your bright face so dark
It doesn’t suit you, it’s no use
Hey, hey, pop, pop
Let’s be more flexible

lines.lyric: Wae jageun mal hanmadie ttodashi gabbunssa
lines.lyric_hangul: 왜 작은 말 한마디에 또다시 갑분싸
lines.lyric_translation: Why make things awkward with one word?

lines.lyric: Gibun ssahaejil piryo eopshi geureon maldeureun
lines.lyric_hangul: 기분 싸해질 필요 없이 그런 말들은
lines.lyric_translation: No need for feelings to get sour

lines.lyric: Da mushihago ijen shingyeong sseuji mabshida
lines.lyric_hangul: 다 무시하고 이젠 신경 쓰지 맙시다
lines.lyric_translation: Ignore all those words, don’t care about it
Why do you look like you’re gonna cry?
Let’s smile, you’re gonna get wrinkles
Even if you laugh it over, each day isn’t enough

lines.lyric: Bujokhal tende jom gamjeong gatgo jangnanhaji mabshida
lines.lyric_hangul: 부족할 텐데 좀 감정 갖고 장난하지 맙시다
lines.lyric_translation: So let’s not joke around with emotions
